copy.tagline: 切换幻灯片主题并打开提词器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用终端制作或展示幻灯片
copy.tagline_en: Switch slide themes and open teleprompter
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often create or present slides in terminal

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成一个演讲者专用的幻灯片模板，每页附带 150-300 字的逐字稿，右下角有工具栏，支持切换主题和打开提词器弹窗。
howto.when: 当你需要准备演讲或演示，并希望有逐字稿和提词功能时，可以要求 Claude 使用此技能。

say.text: 帮我创建一个演讲者模式的幻灯片，主题用 tokyo-night。
say.note: Claude 会生成带逐字稿和工具栏的幻灯片。

say.text: 给这个演示加上提词器弹窗。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate a presenter-specific slide template with 150-300 word speaker notes per page, a toolbar at the bottom right for theme switching and teleprompter popup.
howto.when_en: When you need to prepare a presentation or demo and want speaker notes and teleprompter functionality, you can ask Claude to use this skill.

say_en.text: Create a presenter mode slide deck with the tokyo-night theme.
say_en.note: Claude will generate slides with notes and toolbar.

say_en.text: Add a teleprompter popup to this presentation.
